Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the initial analysis by failing to correctly identify the subject of the query. The user asked for the maternal grandfather of "Prince Harald Of Schaumburg-Lippe." The Planner incorrectly assumed this referred to the famous 19th-century Prince Harald of Denmark (son of Frederick VIII), who was the father of Princess Feodora. In reality, the query refers to the 20th-century Prince Harald of Schaumburg-Lippe (born 1948), who is the son of Prince Christian of Schaumburg-Lippe and Princess Feodora of Denmark. Because the Planner started with the wrong individual, the entire subsequent search strategy was flawed, leading to the incorrect conclusion that the maternal grandfather was Frederick VIII of Denmark (who is actually the great-great-grandfather of the correct subject). The error was a failure to disambiguate the namesake individuals at the very first step.
